prompt: Write a recorded statement transcript (about 250 words) between an insurance adjuster (lines start with 'Q:') and the claimant (lines start with 'A:'). The claimant was the driver in a side impact at intersection in Houston, Texas, and has knee injury. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1467; do not mention it.)
text:
Q: Thank you for agreeing to give this recorded statement. Please state your full name for the record.

A: I'd rather not give my name on a recording, but you can reference the claim number.

Q: That's fine. Can you tell me where the accident happened?

A: It was at an intersection in Houston, Texas. I was going straight through a green light when a car came across from the side street.

Q: Which direction were you traveling, and what part of your vehicle was hit?

A: I was heading east. The other car hit my driver's side door, right around the middle of the car.

Q: Were you wearing a seatbelt?

A: Yes, I always do.

Q: Did the airbags deploy?

A: The side curtain airbag came out, I think. The front ones did not.

Q: Did you feel any pain right after the collision?

A: Not right away. My left knee hit the dashboard area and started aching within an hour or so. By that evening it was swollen and I could barely bend it.

Q: Have you seen a doctor for the knee?

A: Yes, I went to urgent care the next morning. They took X-rays and told me to follow up with an orthopedic specialist for an MRI.

Q: Do you have any prior injuries to that knee?

A: Nothing serious. I had some soreness years ago from running, but nothing that stopped me from working.

Q: Is there anything else you'd like to add?

A: Only that I've missed several days of work because I can't stand for long periods. I'm still trying to get my knee sorted out.

Q: Thank you. This concludes the statement.
